Backend: 22/22 pytest passing on /app/backend/tests/test_drivemate_iter3.py — student booking flow (double-book prevention on POST /api/slots returns 409; POST /api/slots/{id}/book flips to Booked; duplicate at same date+time for the same student returns 409; GET /api/my/lessons scoped to owner; POST /api/slots/{id}/cancel clears student fields), Admin User Manager (list/promote/demote/delete + self-safety 400 on demote/delete self, 403 for students), Analytics returns {users, slots, revenue, fleet} with expected sub-keys, Payments (4 packages, POST /api/payments/checkout returns real stripe.com URL + pending row, /payments/status, /payments/my and /admin/payments), Messaging (directory: students see only instructor/admin; admin sees all except self; send/thread/order asc). Frontend Playwright verified: admin default tab = Analytics; sidebar shows Analytics, User Manager, Payments, Messages, Fleet Manager, Instructor Roster, Calendar Slots, Profile (all 8 present); 4 analytics stat cards (an-revenue/users/bookings/fleet) render; User Manager shows 3 rows with the admin's own delete button DISABLED (1 of 3), role Select works; Payments page shows all 4 pkg cards with buy buttons; Messages: contacts list appears (2 contacts including Test Student), typing + Send stored a message and it appeared in the thread. Student portal (session_token=test_student_token_2026): default tab = Book Lesson; admin-only sidebar items (analytics/users/fleet/roster/scheduler) all HIDDEN; student sees only book/my-lessons/payments/messages/profile; MyLessons page loads; clicking Buy on Pro Pack ($200) actually redirected to a real Stripe sandbox checkout page — verified by screenshot showing 'Sandbox3 · US$200.00 · Powered by Stripe'.

minor.issue: Double-booking uniqueness key is (date,time,vehicle_id). If vehicle_id is null/absent, two slots with same date+time and null vehicle_id will still trigger the 409 (matching on null==null). This is currently working as intended for the tests but is a design edge-case worth documenting.
Endpoint returns 200 {ok:true} even when user_id does not exist (silent no-op). Consider 404 for a non-existent id for API hygiene. Non-blocking.

issues: 'Most Popular' neon badge IS rendered in source above the Pro card (line 61 in Payments.jsx) — visible on screen but may render slightly early/late during a very fast tab switch; not a defect, just noting that automation must wait for the card to hydrate before asserting the badge text.

action_items: (Optional) Return 404 from DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} when the user does not exist.
(Optional) Document that double-booking uniqueness triple is (date,time,vehicle_id) and behaviour when vehicle_id is null.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/slots correctly enforces double-booking on (date,time,vehicle_id). Note: matches when vehicle_id is None on both sides — consider excluding null from the uniqueness check if unassigned slots should be allowed.
server.py POST /api/slots/{id}/book uses $or on student_id OR student_email for the per-student time conflict — solid protection for both authenticated user_id and legacy email-only matches.

server.py POST /api/slots/{id}/cancel sets student_id=None but leaves the reminder_sent_at reset — good; keep in mind if slot is re-booked later it won't send reminder unless it hits the 24h window again.
server.py DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} — silent 200 for non-existent user (see minor above).
server.py PATCH /api/admin/users/{user_id} correctly guards self-demotion (400) but does NOT prevent an admin from being demoted by ANOTHER admin — acceptable in multi-admin systems; document.
server.py /api/payments/checkout writes a payment_transactions row with payment_status=pending before Stripe returns — good pattern; matches emergentintegrations playbook.
server.py /api/payments/status/{session_id} polls Stripe and updates only if not already paid — race-safe.
server.py /api/messages/threads uses $cond aggregation to derive peer_id — clean; enriches with user profile before returning.
Frontend Sidebar.jsx uses role-based filtering with a single ALL_ITEMS array — clean and easy to extend.
Frontend Dashboard.jsx sets default tab from DEFAULT_TAB_BY_ROLE — verified admin→analytics, student→book, instructor→roster all correct.

Frontend Payments.jsx redirects to real Stripe checkout via window.location — verified live in test; consider adding a loading spinner between buy click and redirect (already exists via Loader2 on button).
